contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: contemporary copy of a dupondius of Claudius dating AD41-54. Reverse: CERES AVGVSTA. RIC I, c.f. nos. 94/110; Boon c.f. plate III, nos. 39-40. Reece period 2. Obverse: bareheaded bust left Obverse inscription: [---]LAVD Reverse: Ceres seated left holding corn-ears and torch Reverse inscription:[ CERES AVGVSTA]. Dimensions: diameter: 25.48mm; weight: 7.35g. Identification by Sam Moorhead, PAS Finds Advisor Iron Age and Roman coins
